title: -fips images are no longer published — FIPS is a runtime switch on the standard image

detection.reason: read from the image TAG of the ebs-csi-controller / ebs-csi-node workloads — a digest-pinned image (@sha256:…) or a mirror that renames the tag is not resolved and reads clean

quote: The `-fips` container images are no longer built or released.
remediation: Replace -fips image overrides with the standard image and turn FIPS on at runtime instead (EKS add-on / Helm `fips: true`): from v1.63 no -fips images are published, so an override pinned to a -fips tag cannot move to any newer release.
verifyCommand: kubectl -n kube-system get deploy/ebs-csi-controller ds/ebs-csi-node -o json | jq -r '.items[] | .metadata.name as $w | .spec.template.spec.containers[] | select(.image | test("-fips")) | "\($w): \(.image)"'  # each printed container pins a -fips image that is no longer published
